content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are centralized platforms. They offer payment processing, product hosting, and delivery—but only if your country is on their approved list. For creators in Nigeria, these platforms are entirely inaccessible. Workarounds like using a friend’s account or VPN are temporary and risky. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, is a decentralized architecture. It combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. You own every component. No platform can shut you down or change the rules mid-game. This isn’t a hack—it’s a permanent base-layer alternative.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Centralized platforms exclude countries based on compliance costs, not your merit. Nigeria, alongside Ghana, Kenya, and others, is locked out due to perceived financial risk. These platforms prioritize markets with stable currencies and legal frameworks. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack bypasses this entirely. It uses open-source tools and blockchain payments, neither of which discriminate by geography. Your store runs on GitHub Pages, a platform that hosts code, not transactions. Payments are processed on-chain via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC. This architecture is immune to country-based restrictions because it doesn’t rely on any single jurisdiction.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction—if you could use them. Crypto payments via NOWPayments cost 0.5% with no monthly fees. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack automates payment verification and product delivery the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. No waiting for payouts. No chargebacks. No hidden costs. Compare this to Gumroad or Paddle, which hold funds for days and deduct additional fees for international transfers. With sovereign infrastructure, your revenue is yours the moment it’s earned—no platform as middleman.
Centralized platforms exclude countries. Sovereign infrastructure doesn’t.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With centralized platforms, your store, customer data, and revenue are all held hostage. Stripe can freeze your account. Gumroad can change its terms. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack gives you full ownership. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and immutable. Orders are stored in Supabase, a database you control. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, with no bandwidth fees. Automation is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring instant product delivery without manual intervention. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own the keys. You set the rules.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria and need to sell digital products today, centralized platforms are not an option. Workarounds are temporary and risky. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours, includes 5 products loaded, and comes with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration. It’s built for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. If you’re selling ebooks, courses, or templates and need a system that works regardless of your location, this is the architecture to choose. It’s not just a store—it’s financial sovereignty.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The stack is designed for digital creators, not developers. COREMERCH handles deployment and provides 30-day support. You’ll receive a fully operational store with 5 products loaded and email security configured.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay monthly fees for this stack?
No. The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge for crypto payments.
What happens if a payment fails or is disputed?
Crypto payments are irreversible once confirmed on-chain. There are no chargebacks. If a payment fails, the customer must retry. The system automates verification, so you’re never manually involved.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is built on scalable infrastructure. You can add more products, increase traffic, and expand functionality without changing the core architecture.
